FIX.TITLE: Fix with AI
FIX.SUBTITLE: “{name}” is {chars} characters long; the agent receives up to {max} of each response.
FIX.INTRO: First, what the agent can't use is cleaned up (embedded images, HTML, repeated paragraphs). If that's not enough, AI proposes splitting or condensing it according to its shape, without losing any data. Nothing is saved until you accept.
FIX.RUNNING: AI is building the proposal and checking nothing is lost. It takes 10 to 60 seconds.
FIX.STALE: The response changed since this proposal was made. Request a new one.
FIX.APPLIED: Done: {count} response(s) saved. They are vectorized and audited automatically.
FIX.FORCE: What these checks flag no longer applies: accept anyway

FALLBACK.rebalanced: A part was still over the limit: it was split by paragraphs, without rewriting it.
FALLBACK.mechanical: Condensing lost content: the original was split by paragraphs, without rewriting it.

CHECKS.NO_DUPLICATES: No duplicate parts nor equal to another response

CHECKS.TOO_MUCH_CHANGE: AI changed more than needed: review the changes
CHECKS.PAIR_BAD: Still similar ({before} → {after}): merging may be better

TITLES.oversize: Fix with AI: over the limit

SUBTITLES.oversize: {names} is {chars} characters long; the agent receives up to {max} of each response.
SUBTITLES.writing: {names}: only what the audit flagged is fixed, the rest stays as is.
SUBTITLES.merge: {names}: become one with everything from both, without repeating.
SUBTITLES.separate: {names}: each keeps its own topic and stops repeating the other.
SUBTITLES.resolve: {names}: choose which data is correct and AI fixes only that.

INTROS.oversize: First, what the agent can't use is cleaned up (embedded images, HTML, repeated paragraphs). If that's not enough, AI proposes splitting or condensing it by its shape, without losing data. Nothing is saved until you accept.
INTROS.writing: AI fixes the flagged problems and obvious typos; you'll see the changes marked word by word. Nothing is saved until you accept.
INTROS.merge: AI combines both with everything either has. The one with a category or group (or the oldest) is kept and the other is deleted on accept; you can undo it in History.
INTROS.separate: AI rewrites both so each covers only its topic. Neither is deleted; anything removed from one must remain in the other.
INTROS.resolve: AI can't know which data is correct: choose it for each contradiction. You can look for the wrong data in other responses and fix them too.

RESOLVE.FIND_ELSEWHERE: Look for the wrong data in other responses
RESOLVE.NOWHERE_ELSE: It doesn't appear in any other response.
RESOLVE.ALSO_IN: The wrong data also appears in these responses. Check the ones to fix too (it may be the same number with another meaning: review):

FIX.NOT_ADVISED: AI recommends not separating them: {reason}. You can merge them or dismiss the finding.
FIX.LOST_GROUPS: Note: the deleted one was in group {groups} used by an agent; the merged one doesn't keep it.
FIX.APPLIED_UNDO: Done. It's vectorized and audited automatically; you can undo it in Audit → History.

BULK.TITLE: Fix spelling and numbering
BULK.SUBTITLE: Responses with spelling mistakes or broken numbering. Review the changes and apply the checked ones; the rest go one by one.
BULK.NONE: There are no responses with only spelling or numbering issues.
BULK.REVIEW: Review: changed too much or fails a check
